formNameMismatch.description: Tests reference accountForm/emailForm but component has passwordForm/codeLoginForm

activeTabDefaultMismatch.description: Tests expect 'account' but component defaults to 'password'

fieldValidationMismatch.description: Tests fail because accountForm/emailForm are undefined

isFieldInvalidMismatch.description: Tests call isFieldInvalid which doesn't exist on LoginComponent

apiMethodMismatch.description: Tests mock api.login/emailLogin/sendVerificationCode but component calls loginPassword/loginVerifyCode/loginSendCode

templateContentMismatch.description: Tests expect '#email', '#password' IDs and 'Login'/'Register' button texts

templateRenderingMismatch.description: Tests expect button[type=submit] on login page but component delegates to auth-form component

rootCause: Component was refactored from accountForm/emailForm to passwordForm/codeLoginForm with AuthFormComponent delegation. Active tab default changed from 'account' to 'password'. API methods renamed.
